subject.title: Feature Request: Add Anthropic native web search (web_search_20260209) as a search provider

question: Should OpenClaw accept a narrow Anthropic-native `web_search` provider now, and what opt-in, billing, replay, and security defaults should gate Anthropic-hosted search?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but adding provider-hosted search changes credential use, external data flow, billing, domain/location policy, and session replay semantics, so automation should not choose the permanent contract alone.

options.title: Design gated provider
options.body: Accept the narrow feature only as an Anthropic-plugin-owned provider with explicit opt-in, documented data/billing behavior, replay handling, and live Anthropic proof.

options.title: Fold into server-tools design
options.body: Defer the narrow search provider until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/23353 defines shared policy for Anthropic web_search, web_fetch, code_execution/PTC, and result blocks.

options.title: Decline hosted search for now
options.body: Keep managed web-search providers as the supported path and document that Anthropic-hosted search is not currently planned.

recommendation.title: Design gated provider
recommendation.body: Accept the narrow feature only as an Anthropic-plugin-owned provider with explicit opt-in, documented data/billing behavior, replay handling, and live Anthropic proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the latest visible review context and recent history across the Anthropic provider, transport, manifest, and web-provider boundary surfaces.
